full_judgment: 2. It appears that O.C. Suit No. 169 of 1983 was instituted on 3.8.83 by four plaintiffs, namely, (1) Md. Abdul Baset Khan, (2) Sree Amalendu Kar (3) Sree Ratan Kumar Sarker and (4) Md. Shamsul Alam Bakul, against the Defendants No. 1 and 2 for specific performance of contract. Subsequently, on an application under Order 1, Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure, Defendants Nos. 3-5 were added in the suit. In the application under Order 1 Rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure it was alleged by the added Defendant Nos. 3-5 that they had purchased the suit property by a registered deed dated 16.1.83 from the concerned Defendants. Thereafter, Plaintiffs Nos. 1, 2 and 3 filed an application under Order 6, Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure that Plaintiff No. 4 had been gained over and Plaintiff No. 4 be transposed from the category of the Plaintiff to the category of the defendant and be added as Defendant No. 7 in the suit. In the meantime Plaintiff No. 4 Md. Shamsul Alam Bakul filed an application for compromise with added Defendant Nos. 3-5 and filed a solenama. In the application under Order 6 rule 17, the Plaintiff Nos. 1-3 prayed' for transposing the Plaintiff No. 4 to the category of the Defendant and also to add a paragraph being No. 4 (Ga) in the pleadings as it would be necessary, if the prayer for transposing is allowed by the Court. The learned Subordinate Judge, after hearing the parties, rejected the application filed by Plaintiffs Nos. 1-3 under Order 6, Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure. The application should have been under Order 6 Rule 17 read with Order 1 Rule 10 and Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure. Since prayer for both the reliefs had been made in one application, we need not consider this aspect.
